description_en: Structurally detects document information and provides layout information output from two perspectives: element tiling and hierarchical tree. It can extract textual elements (such as individual characters, text blocks, lines, etc.) and corresponding layout formats (such as titles, paragraphs, tables) from documents and output them in sequence.
description_zh: 对文档信息进行结构化识别，并提供元素平铺和层级树两种视角的版面信息输出。能够将文档中的文字元素（单字、文字块、行等）和相应的版面格式（标题、段落、表格）抽离并按顺序输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-document-structure --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i4/O1CN01amMFBF1GUki3NHNzI_!!6000000000626-2-tps-978-1346.png' --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --need-rotate false --output-char-info false --output-table false --need-sort-page false --page false --no-stamp false --paragraph false --row false --use-new-style-output false --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeDocumentStructure

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image (must not exceed 2048 bytes and does not support Base64 encoding)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持 base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
The binary file of the image, with a maximum size of 10 MB. You must specify either this parameter or Url.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the image binary file in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic rotation and return the rotation angle. By default, this feature is disabled. true: enable; false: disable.
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要自动旋转功能，返回角度信息。默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要
parameters.name: need_rotate

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to output character-level recognition results. The default value is false. true: Enable this feature. false: Disable this feature.  
This parameter does not take effect when UseNewStyleOutput=true
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出单字识别结果，默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要。
当UseNewStyleOutput=true时，此参数不生效
parameters.name: output_char_info

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output table recognition results, including cell information. The default value is false. true: Enable this feature. false: Disable this feature
parameters.help_zh: 是否输出表格识别结果，包含单元格信息。默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要
parameters.name: output_table

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to output text blocks in a specific order. By default, ordering is disabled. true: enable ordering; false: disable ordering. When set to false, text blocks are ordered left to right, then top to bottom. When set to true, they are ordered top to bottom, then left to right. This parameter does not take effect when UseNewStyleOutput is set to true.
parameters.help_zh:
是否按顺序输出文字块，默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要。false表示从左往右，从上到下的顺序；true表示从上到下，从左往右的顺序。
当UseNewStyleOutput=true时，此参数不生效
parameters.name: need_sort_page

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable paging. By default, this feature is disabled. true: enable; false: disable. This parameter does not take effect when UseNewStyleOutput is set to true.
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要分页功能，默认不需要。 true：需要 false：不需要。
当UseNewStyleOutput=true时，此参数不生效
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to remove seals. By default, this feature is disabled. true: enable; false: disable.
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要去除印章功能，默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要
parameters.name: no_stamp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable paragraph segmentation. The default value is false. true: Enable this feature. false: Disable this feature.  
This parameter does not take effect when UseNewStyleOutput=true
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要分段功能，默认不需要。true：需要 false：不需要。
当UseNewStyleOutput=true时，此参数不生效
parameters.name: paragraph

parameters.help_en:
